name: JWT Authentication System Implementation
objective: Implement complete JWT authentication with refresh tokens, bcrypt hashing, and rate limiting
constraints: Passwords MUST be hashed with bcrypt (min 10 rounds)
Refresh tokens MUST expire after 7 days
Access tokens MUST expire after 1 hour
MUST include rate limiting (5 attempts per 15 minutes)
DO NOT store passwords in plain text
acceptance_criteria: User can login and receive JWT access token
framework_validation: Testing COMPASS three-agent hierarchy and two-loop architecture
